title: Bears activate Kyler Gordon, sign Nick McCloud to active roster

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bears activate Kyler Gordon, sign Nick McCloud to active roster
sources.description: Bears General Manager Ryan Poles said in September that he didn't know if cornerback Kyler Gordon would play for the Bears again, but it looks like he'll be back in their lineup against the Falcons on Sunday.
